additional_info.subject: RE: ID0448487-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S7 170003961]-Charging Issue CRM:02678000354
additional_info.body:
Good morning Mr. Ceniou,
Thank you for your reply! Here is the analysis of the events you reported:
At
Sep 08, 2025, 01:05:09 PM
there is the first Unavailable state communicated, as a consequence of the Hard reboot that you launched.
Before this event, there are no "Unavailable" or "Faulted" status changes. If the outlets were shown as "Faulted" I believe this might be a visualization error from Sifinity side, because no event was recorded.
At
Sep 08, 2025, 01:05:13 PM
we have the second communication of all outlets unavailable before actually rebooting.
After the reboot, at
Sep 08, 2025, 01:11:29 PM
the Mainbreaker was closed, clearing the error.
The unavailability of the outlets started at
Sep 08, 2025, 01:05:23 PM
and was cleared at
Sep 08, 2025, 01:13:14 PM
, when the outlets became available again:
At
Sep 08, 2025, 02:10:43 PM
, a charging session on DC1 was stopped correctly by the EV:
From OCPP messages, we communicate the following status sequence:
No faulted status is communicated to the Backend, but Sifinity reports it as Faulted.
At
Sep 09, 2025, 05:17:15 AM
again a charging session is ending, and Sifinity reports a Faulted status, while the OCPP statusNotifications that is communicated to the backend are:
In conclusion, Sifinity is still undergoing an improvement process for what concerns status reporting. I believe the "Faulted" status is derived from the pilot state going to E at the end of each charging session. I  internally to report such behavior and it will be taken care from the Sifinity development team. For the time being, I would recommend to refer mostly to the StatusNotifications from Backend side.
If there are no further questions on these events, I will proceed to close this ticket.
Looking forwrad to hearing feedback form you!
With kind regards,
